sources.snippet: L3-8B-Stheno-v3.1-GGUF Original model: L3-8B-Stheno-v3.1 Description This repo contains GGUF format model files for L3-8B-Stheno-v3.1. About GGUF GGUF is a new format introduced by the llama.cpp team on August 21st 2023. It is a replacement for GGML, which is no longer supported by llama.cpp.
